subject: Media Literacy
title: Digital Literacy for the Future
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Digital Literacy for the Future.

hook.text: AI-generated faces, voices, and videos are now indistinguishable from real ones. Can you trust anything you see online?

buildup.text: As technology evolves, the skills needed to navigate social media will become more complex and essential.

discovery.text: Future literacy includes detecting AI content, understanding algorithmic bias, and protecting digital identity.

twist.text: Schools teach math and science but rarely teach how to navigate the digital environment where students spend hours daily.

climax.text: Digital literacy isn't optional anymore. It's a survival skill for participating in modern democracy.

punchline.text: The internet won't get simpler. Your skills need to keep up.

quiz.question: Why is digital literacy increasingly important?
options: It helps you get more followers
AI and evolving technology make it harder to distinguish real from fake
It's only important for tech workers
